subject: Finova MAP: SLA exception request + weekly MAP status and exec update
messages:
From: Sara Miles <sara@finova.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@finova.com>; procurement@finova.com
Date: 2027-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP check + SLA exception request (latency spikes)

Hi Hannah / team,

We're seeing repeated latency spikes on the Redwood inference endpoint tied to our evaluation runs over the past 48 hours. This is impacting our close timeline — the executive team asked for a MAP-level update and a temporary SLA exception to allow priority support while we stabilize. Can we get an executive-level update and an agreed action register by EOD today?

High-level:
- Problem: intermittent 95th percentile token latency jumps (from ~120ms to 1.2s) during batch evaluation runs
- Impact: blocked quality-signoff and demo with procurement (scheduled 2027-03-22)
- Ask: priority support + temporary SLA exception (72h) for capacity bump and debug access

Sample IDs: req-ff12ab, req-ff12ac (I'll attach a short snapshot)

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Miles
Director, Platform Engineering | Finova Corp

Attachment: finova_latency_snapshot_20270316.png

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Miles <sara@finova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, procurement@finova.com
Date: 2027-03-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP check + SLA exception request (latency spikes)

Sara — thanks for flagging and for the snapshot. We appreciate the heads-up and want to treat this as a priority.

Quick plan (proposed MAP action register):
1) Triage & traces (owner: Rishi) — collect server traces, KV cache hit rates, and request-level latencies (target: +12h)
2) Temporary capacity bump (owner: Hannah + Ops) — enable burst nodes for 72h under SLA exception, pending approval (target: +3h to approve)
3) Instrumentation change (owner: Monica) — enable verbose debugging for a narrow window (requires Finova sign-off)
4) Exec sync (owner: Hannah) — 30-min sponsor update w/ Finova execs tomorrow morning to confirm timelines and go/no-go for procurement demo

I've attached a working MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v3.xlsx) and will open a priority internal ticket. Can Rishi confirm whether debug logging is safe to enable on Finova's tenant? Karthik — please advise on approvals and any discount/credits conversation we should prepare for the execs.

I'll follow up with an internal triage note and proposed time for the exec sync.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Adding triage detail and owners. Internal only notes quoted below for the team; I'll keep Sara in the loop for major milestones.

Internal triage checklist (today):
- Rishi: collect traces + histogram of sequence lengths, GPU utilization snapshots, and model variant in use. (ETA: 14:00 PST). Please attach logs to INF-4321.
- Ops: standby to bump capacity by +2 x A100 equivalent for the 72h window once leadership signs off. Hannah to coordinate with Thomas in Ops.
- Karthik: lead the SLA exception approval and coordinate with finance/procurement. If procurement insists on written approval, we'll prepare a 72h SLA amendment with limited scope.

Related: mapped the ask to the deal: DEAL-9081. Pushing for fastest route: temporary capacity + targeted debug beats long-term config changes for now.

Attachment: support_trace_instructions.txt (internal steps to collect traces; Rishi follow).

I'm on it. Quick updates:
- I can reproduce the latency pattern on an isolated eval run when I replayed req-ff12ab. Initial signal looks like KV cache thrash when batch sizes change mid-run.
- I'll capture detailed traces and GPU telemetry and post to INF-4321 by 16:00 PST.
- Request: Finova, can you confirm permission to enable verbose debug mode for two 30-min windows? That will surface request headers and cache keys. If yes, please reply with "permission: granted" and the preferred window (we suggested 03/19 09:00-09:30 and 15:00-15:30 PST).

Next steps: traces posted to ticket; Ops standby for capacity bump after Hannah confirms approval.
